results.summary: This project integrates a KianV RV32IMA RISC-V processor with an SV32 MMU and hardware caches into a Linux-capable SoC. The processor supports virtual memory through two-level page table translation and separate instruction and data TLBs. The SoC includes external QSPI PSRAM, SPI NOR flash, and memory-mapped UART, SPI, and GPIO peripherals. It is intended to boot Linux, uClinux, and xv6, and uses Pmod boards for external memory and optional Ethernet.

It uses three oscillators and an ADSR envelope to generate tones from a 7-bit MIDI note number and a gate signal. The audio output is provided as a PWM signal on uo[7].
